Interior Design and Architecture Under One Roof

Most projects need more than one kind of expertise. A new home needs architecture, interiors and furniture. A salon needs layout planning, plumbing coordination and branding. An office needs space planning, acoustics and project management. At 9th Corner, interior design and architecture are handled by one team, so every part of the project is planned together and nothing falls between consultants. Over 22 years we have delivered more than 800 spaces this way.

Our Services at a Glance

For homes

  • Residential interior design: homes planned around your daily routine, from apartments to large family houses.
  • Luxury home interior design: high-end residences built on proportion, fine materials and layered lighting.
  • Modern interior design: clean, warm contemporary interiors with clever hidden storage.
  • Farmhouse interior designer: relaxed retreats that combine rustic character with modern comfort.

For businesses

  • Interior designer for office: workplaces designed around how your teams actually work.
  • Interior architect for showroom design: showrooms planned around sightlines, circulation and product lighting.
  • Salon interior designer and best salon interior designer: salons that flatter clients and run smoothly for staff.

Across every project

  • Architecture services: concept design, working drawings and site supervision for new buildings and renovations.
  • Interior design services: our complete design-to-execution offer.
  • Top interior design firm and best interior designers: how our team and process deliver consistent results.

How Our Interior Design and Architecture Process Works

  1. Consultation: a free first meeting to understand your space, goals, budget and timeline.
  2. Brief and survey: accurate measurements and a written brief that guides the design.
  3. Concept and planning: layouts, mood boards and material directions.
  4. 3D visualisation: photorealistic views and walkthroughs, refined with you.
  5. Working drawings: detailed drawings coordinated across structure, services and interiors.
  6. Procurement and execution: supervised work on site to a fixed timeline.
  7. Handover: a finished space backed by our 10-year warranty.

Why Combine Interior Design and Architecture?

When the building and its interiors are planned together, windows land where furniture needs light, beams avoid wardrobe walls and electrical points match the final layout. Combining interior design and architecture also means one point of accountability, one schedule and one budget. It is simpler for you and produces a more coherent result.

Choosing the Right Service

Not sure where to start? These questions usually point the way:

  • Is the building already built? If yes, start with interior design. If not, bring in our architects first so interior design and architecture develop together.
  • Is it a home or a business? Homes are planned around family routines. Businesses are planned around customers, staff and brand.
  • How much of the space is changing? A single room, a full renovation or a new build each need a different scope.
  • What is your timeline? A fixed move-in or opening date shapes how the project is phased.

At the first consultation, our team will recommend the right combination of services for your project and explain clearly what each stage involves and what it will cost.

Who We Work With

Our clients include homeowners, families planning a weekend farmhouse, business owners opening a new office, retail brands launching a showroom, and salon owners building or refreshing an outlet. Each project is different, but every client gets the same careful planning, the same transparent pricing and the same commitment to delivering what was promised. That consistency across very different types of interior design and architecture work is one of the reasons clients return to us.

Furniture Design and Vastu

Custom furniture is one of our core services. Wardrobes, kitchens, consoles, beds and display units are designed for each room and made to the same standard as the rest of the project. For clients who want it, Vastu principles are built into our interior design and architecture from the first layout rather than added at the end.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I hire you for design only?

Talk to us about your needs at the first consultation. We will explain the scope options and recommend the approach that suits your project best.

Do you take on renovations as well as new builds?

Yes. Our interior design and architecture team works on renovations, extensions and fit-outs of existing spaces as well as new buildings.

Transparent, Accountable Delivery

Our pricing is milestone-based with no hidden costs, our timelines are fixed, and our work carries a 10-year warranty. You always know which stage your project is at, what has been completed and what comes next. A 98% client retention rate and a 4.8 Google rating reflect the trust our clients place in us.

Talk to Us

We work across Delhi NCR and Karnal from our head office in Pitampura, Delhi, and our branch in Gurgaon. Browse our projects, learn more about us, or book a free consultation to discuss interior design and architecture for your next home or business space.
